title: Timeline, mitigation before diagnosis, and the person whose job is to write it down

videos.script: Six o'clock, and the Billing team has a choice. They are fairly sure which change is double-charging the shops. {{choice}} They could find the bug and fix it. Or they could undo the whole release, and look afterwards. {{options}} Every minute spent looking is another minute of shops being charged twice. {{minutes}} So they undo it. Eleven minutes later, the double charges stop. Finding the bug takes the next day. {{undo}} That is the first rule of this lesson. Stop the harm first. Understand it later. {{rule}} The second is about the person who writes everything down while it happens, with the time beside it. {{scribe}} From those notes, you will measure the incident phase by phase, and see where its minutes went. {{phases}} Most of them went before anybody knew anything was wrong. {{before}}
